narration: You signed your name next to theirs to help them get a loan. Seemed like a kind thing to do. Here's what that one signature actually means for you.
visual: Dark background. Two person silhouettes shaking hands over a co-sign contract document. Title: 'THE CO-SIGN TRAP'. Subtitle: 'One signature. Someone else's debt.'

narration: As the co-signer, you're 100% legally responsible for every dollar — not just if they can't pay, but the second they miss any payment at all.
visual: Light background. SVG balance scale with 'BORROWER' on one side and 'YOU' on the other, both showing '$21K'. Bold text: 'EQUALLY LIABLE'. Sub-text: 'MISS ONE PAYMENT → YOUR CREDIT PAYS'.

narration: Here's what nobody tells you before you sign — nearly one in three co-signers ends up being asked to pay the full loan themselves. Number three is the one you don't see coming.
visual: Dark background. Grid of 10 person silhouettes, 3 highlighted in red with dollar signs. Large animated counter rolling up to '28%'. Text: 'OF CO-SIGNERS PAY THE DEBT'.

narration: And if they're even one day late? Your credit score takes the hit immediately — we're talking forty to eighty points, wiping out years of work you did.
visual: Light background. Animated credit score gauge dropping from 750 to 670. Red alert notification: 'LATE PAYMENT REPORTED'. Bold red stamp: '-80 PTS'.

narration: The money damage is bad enough — but 38% of co-signers say it permanently damaged or destroyed that relationship with the person they tried to help.
visual: Dark background. Two person silhouettes starting close together then slowly drifting apart with a jagged rift line between them. '38%' springs in large in red. Text: 'SAY IT DAMAGED THE RELATIONSHIP'.

narration: Next time someone asks you to co-sign? Offer them a gift instead. Your credit score is worth more than the favor — follow for more money traps they never taught you.
visual: Light background. Side-by-side comparison: green gift box labeled 'GIVE $500' with checkmark vs red contract labeled 'CO-SIGN $21K' with X. CTA: 'HELP WITHOUT RISKING YOUR CREDIT'.
